rule: RS-15. Each entry is one limit the syllabus states, or one A Level topic the AS route excludes, with the pattern C-11 scans learner-facing text for. The sentence is the syllabus’s; the pattern is our judgement of what teaching past the limit would look like. Every contract in the subject carries every entry.

must_catch: the coefficient of friction between the block and the slope
must_allow: Friction acts against the motion of the block.
The drag force increases as the speed increases.

entries.syllabus_sentence: no treatment of the coefficients of friction and viscosity is required, and a simple model of drag force increasing as speed increases is sufficient

must_allow: The relative speed of approach equals the relative speed of separation.

entries.syllabus_sentence: knowledge of the concept of coefficient of restitution is not required

entries.construct: deformation in more than one dimension

must_allow: The tensile stress in the wire is 2.0 × 10⁸ Pa.

entries.syllabus_sentence: forces and deformations will be assumed to be in one dimension only

entries.construct: the Doppler effect for a moving observer

must_catch: a moving observer hears a higher note
when the observer moves towards the source
must_allow: The source moves towards a stationary observer.
The observed frequency is higher than the source frequency.

entries.syllabus_sentence: understanding of the Doppler effect for a stationary source and a moving observer is not required

entries.construct: an unpolarised wave through a polarising filter, calculated

must_catch: Unpolarised light passes through the filter and its intensity halves.
the intensity falls to I0/2 for unpolarised light
must_allow: Plane-polarised light of intensity I0 passes through a filter at 60°, so I = I0 cos²60° = 0.25 I0.
Sunlight is unpolarised.

entries.syllabus_sentence: calculation of the effect of a polarising filter on the intensity of an unpolarised wave is not required

must_catch: add the end correction to the length of the tube
must_allow: The closed end of the tube is a node and the open end an antinode.

entries.syllabus_sentence: it will be assumed that end corrections are negligible; knowledge of the concept of end corrections is not required

must_catch: Use a spectrometer to measure the angle.
the collimator makes the rays parallel
must_allow: Measure the angle between the zero-order and first-order maxima with a protractor.

entries.syllabus_sentence: the structure and use of the spectrometer are not included

must_catch: The resistance of the thermistor increases as the temperature increases.
must_allow: The resistance of the thermistor decreases as the temperature increases.
The resistance of a filament lamp increases as the temperature increases.

entries.syllabus_sentence: it will be assumed that thermistors have a negative temperature coefficient

entries.construct: motion in a circle (A Level topic 12)

must_allow: The phase difference is π/2 rad.
The ball moves in a straight line.

entries.syllabus_sentence: A Level content: 12 Motion in a circle.

must_catch: the gravitational potential at the surface
must_allow: The gravitational potential energy increases by mgΔh.
A uniform gravitational field near the Earth’s surface.

entries.construct: temperature and thermal physics (A Level topics 14 and 16)
entries.pattern: \bspecific (?:heat capacity|latent heat)\b|\blatent heat\b|\bthermal equilibrium\b|\bfirst law of thermodynamics\b|\binternal energy\b

must_catch: the specific heat capacity of water
must_allow: The temperature is measured in kelvin.
Energy is transferred as heat to the surroundings.

entries.construct: ideal gases and kinetic theory (A Level topic 15)

must_allow: The amount of substance is measured in mol.

entries.construct: oscillations and simple harmonic motion (A Level topic 17)

must_allow: Time 20 oscillations of the pendulum.

must_catch: the electric field strength between the plates

must_allow: The galvanometer reads zero at balance.

must_allow: Nucleon number and charge are conserved in the decay.
